item.title: Lego Net Profit Up 32% In First Half, 'Stronger Than Expected': CEO To AFP
item.description: Lego, the world's biggest toy maker by revenue, posted "stronger than expected" earnings for the first half of the year, its chief executive told AFP, with net profit rising 32 percent. Delivered by PolitePaul service

item.title: German GDP Growth Revised Upwards, Defying Iran War Turmoil
item.description: German growth rose faster than previously estimated in the second quarter thanks to strong exports, official data showed Tuesday, as Europe's biggest economy defied the turmoil unleashed by the Iran war. Delivered by PolitePaul service

item.title: Trees 'Giving Up': Climate Change Hammers Historic English Gardens
item.description: At Hampton Court Palace, head gardener Graham Dillamore strode across the burnt beige grass in the spectacular formal gardens southwest of London, laid out in the 17th century. Delivered by PolitePaul service
